explanation: First compact away every b while counting a entries. Then walk the compacted prefix backward, writing two d entries for each a and copying other characters. Backward expansion avoids overwriting unread input.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for the logical input and expanded result.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the supplied capacity.
